fields.acceptance: A test installs with ctx.Self set to an absolute path and finds that path nowhere in rhiza.lua, which reads local BIN = settings.bin or "rhiza" with an empty or non-string bin falling back to "rhiza"; a reinstall keeps a bin the owner set in the settings block byte for byte, and a second install is byte-identical
fields.statement: The app actions rhiza rex install writes run rhiza from the PATH of the host running the pane, or from an optional bin entry in rhiza.lua's settings block, never from a path fixed at install time
